name: com.assetgen.unity
description: Text or a picture to an animated character, a prop or a diorama, or a description to a whole scene, inside the Editor. Imports assetgen characters (.glb + .assetgen) as ready-to-use prefabs with an Animator Controller and a locomotion blend tree, props and dioramas as prefabs with their colliders, and scenes as static prefabs with a collider per placed object; generates new ones from an assetgen server, and adds `assetgen` commands to the Unity CLI.
